request.prompt:
M17 enemy sprite sheet
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production 2D tower-defense Goblin SCOUT sprite atlas, 24 distinct poses on a genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Reference image: the recent purple goblin sheet is a STYLE reference only. Match its hand-painted leather, moss-green skin, steel, light direction, soft dark contour, readable detail and three-quarter overhead camera. The NEW character is the scout: slender green goblin, long springy legs, brown leather cap, short ragged OCHRE-ORANGE cape, light brown leather straps and boots, TWO small steel daggers. No purple hood or purple tunic. He must read as a faster, lighter enemy than the purple raider. The orange cape is the main recognition cue.
Canvas 1536x1024 landscape. Place exactly SIX columns and FOUR rows, one complete isolated pose in each of 24 slots. Do not paint grid lines. Keep generous genuinely transparent gaps between actors. Each standing actor is about 175px head-to-feet, with uniform scale across rows and directions. Keep whole ears, cape, daggers, hands and boots within each slot, with generous padding on every side. Do not let neighboring poses touch. The game will use per-pose atlas rectangles, so clear separation and complete silhouettes matter more than filling slots.
Camera: fixed three-quarter overhead, about 35 degrees down; body stays upright on screen. Same warm upper-left light in every pose, even back views. No horizon, ground, scenery or perspective tile.
EXACT ordering, zero-based columns:
Row 0 NORTH (back visible): column 0 idle, 1 walk A left step, 2 walk B passing, 3 walk C right step, 4 walk D passing; column 5 death frame 1, front/SOUTH view, staggering.
Row 1 EAST (right-facing): column 0 idle, 1 walk A, 2 walk B, 3 walk C, 4 walk D; column 5 death frame 2, same front view, knees buckle.
Row 2 SOUTH (face visible): column 0 idle, 1 walk A, 2 walk B, 3 walk C, 4 walk D; column 5 death frame 3, same front view, falling sideways.
Row 3 WEST (left-facing): column 0 idle, 1 walk A, 2 walk B, 3 walk C, 4 walk D; column 5 death frame 4, collapsed and still.
Walk A-B-C-D should loop with opposite arm/leg motion, a light fast forward lean and small orange cape follow-through. Maintain the same camera, character proportions and apparent ground plane. Rear views must show the back of the cap and cape, not a sideways face. The two blades remain attached to the same physical hands across turns. Death is non-graphic, with no blood/gore, around the same feet plane and in four clearly successive poses.
Transparent background: actual alpha=0 outside the characters, clean semitransparent edges, no baked ground shadow, no color matte or glow. No parchment, painted checkerboard, colored backdrop, captions, text, numbers, labels, watermark, UI, ground ellipses or extra actors. Deliver the sprite sheet itself, not a concept poster.

calls.review: Đúng màu cam/style nhưng cần phân biệt thân hình và hai dao.

Skin, scuffed steel, wood grain and leather remain readable when reduced to a 45-48px body in the game. Use broad material planes and soft dark outlines rather than noisy tiny lines.
EXACT ordering, zero-based columns:
ROW 0 NORTH / back toward viewer: c0 idle, c1 walk A left leg forward, c2 walk B passing, c3 walk C right leg forward, c4 walk D passing; c5 death 1 staggering in SOUTH/front view.
ROW 1 EAST / facing screen right: c0 idle, c1 walk A, c2 walk B, c3 walk C, c4 walk D; c5 death 2 knees buckling, same SOUTH/front view.
ROW 2 SOUTH / face toward viewer: c0 idle, c1 walk A, c2 walk B, c3 walk C, c4 walk D; c5 death 3 falling sideways, same SOUTH/front view.
ROW 3 WEST / facing screen left: c0 idle, c1 walk A, c2 walk B, c3 walk C, c4 walk D; c5 death 4 collapsed and still.

Keep the foot ground plane steady. The four death poses form a non-graphic stagger, buckle, fall, collapse sequence, with no gore or blood, and the attached shield follows the arm as the ogre falls.
Transparent background means actual alpha=0 around characters, no painted checkerboard, no parchment, no colored backdrop, ground, contact shadow, glow, guide lines, labels, numbers, captions, watermark, extra weapons or extra characters. Deliver the actual transparent sprite sheet, not an illustrated poster.
